purpose: Teach: 理性/排水/導い/促し/細部/巧み/相関/ヒロイン

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの、本気で、絶対、理性、絶対、的な、絶対、判断、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、尊重しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I truly respect your patient judgment and the medical team's approach. Thank you for your trust in us.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Steady gaze. Warm without sentimentality. The careful precision of someone choosing each word deliberately.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病院の、本気で、絶対、排水、絶対、管理、絶対、貴院、絶対、徹底されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard your hospital's drainage and waste management systems are quite thorough. I'm genuinely impressed, doctor.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with a hint of earnestness. Slight pause before 'thorough'—admiration breaking through his natural hesitation. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんを治療に、本気for、絶対、導いた、絶対、医療チームを、絶対、誇りに、絶対、思っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm proud of how our medical team has guided patients through their treatment with such care and dedication.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Gentle emphasis on 'proud'—not boastful, but honest acknowledgment. Steady rhythm. A brief pause before 'medical team'—pride settling in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんに、本気で、絶対、治療を、絶対、促した、絶対、医師、絶対、信頼されますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: It's clear the doctors who encouraged your treatment are truly trusted by their patients. That speaks volumes, doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reverent tone. Slow, deliberate pacing. Slight breathiness on 'trusted'—he's thinking as he speaks. Ends with genuine appreciation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。検査の、本気で、絶対、細部、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、慎重に、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team examines every detail of test results with careful attention to ensure nothing is overlooked.
lines.style: Patient, methodical delivery. Slight emphasis on 'every detail'—precision matters here. Steady, unhurried pace. The voice of someone used to being thorough.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 手術の、本気で、絶対、巧み、絶対、な、絶対、技術、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、磨いていらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your hospital's surgical techniques are clearly refined through years of practice and skill. That level of expertise is remarkable.
lines.style: Genuine admiration with underlying respect. Voice lifts slightly on 'refined'—he's truly impressed. Slower pace. Ends with quiet sincerity, no flattery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。生活習慣と病気の、本気で、絶対、相関、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、研究しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We study the relationship between lifestyle choices and illness constantly, trying to understand the whole picture of patient care.
lines.style: Patient, reflective tone. Methodical pacing. Slight pause between 'lifestyle' and 'illness'—showing the connection. Ends with quiet conviction about the importance of this work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療ドラマの、本気で、絶対、ヒロイン、絶対、医師、絶対、貴院、絶対、参考にされたんですか?先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Did medical dramas perhaps inspire some of your hospital's approach? I'm curious whether fiction shaped your real-world practice, doctor.
lines.style: Gentle, almost playful curiosity mixed with sincere wonder. Slight smile in the voice. Slower on the final question, inviting reflection rather than quick answer.
